# The Moloch Iron-Forged — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **FUEL** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Feed the Furnace · Siege-Masters:** Feed the Furnace: when a Class 4–5 Moloch unit activates, you may remove 1 model from a friendly [EXPENDABLE] Class 1 unit within 3″: this activation its weapons gain [RELENTLESS] (re-roll Wound rolls) and [ONSLAUGHT 1]. Siege-Masters: Moloch ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER] against units within 3″ of an objective or in Dense terrain.

**Gamble — Red-Line the Boilers** *(risk: durability (dice))*: When a Class 3–5 unit is selected to Shoot or Fight: its weapons get +2 Attacks; afterwards it suffers 1 Fatal Wound for each natural 1 rolled to Hit (max D3+1).

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Feed the Furnace* — Re-roll wounds + crit hits for engines. · *Siege-Masters* — Ignore cover on objectives. · *Red-Line* — Occasional +2 Attacks.

## Detachment — Grand Siege

*Artillery and heavy squads grind fortified positions.*

**Detachment rule:** Bunker-Busters: Siege-Masters also applies to units in Light terrain; [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons do not suffer the −1 to Hit.

**Enhancements**
- **Siege-Lens** (+10 pts, Iron-Smith Forgemaster): The attached unit gets +1 PEN with ranged weapons.
- **Daemon-Bound Shells** (+25 pts, Infernal Bombard): +1 Damage against units in Cover.

**Stratagems**
- **Shattering Bombardment** (1 CP) — *A [SHRAPNEL] weapon hits a Class 1–2 unit:* It suffers −2″ MOV until the End of Round.
- **Creeping Barrage** (1 CP) — *An artillery unit Shoots:* Re-roll Hit rolls against units within 3″ of an objective.
- **Entrench** (1 CP) — *A unit did not Move:* +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) until the End of Round.

## Detachment — Daemon-Forge

*Engines everywhere, smiths keeping them alive.*

**Detachment rule:** Anvil of the Daemon: Class 3–5 units within 6″ of a friendly Leader heal 1 MIGHT at the End of Round.

**Enhancements**
- **Bound Daemon-Heart** (+60 pts, Soul-Furnace Engine): UNYIELDING 5+.
- **Hammer of Moloch** (+10 pts, Daemon-Smith Overseer): Demonic Anvil Repair heals D3+1.

**Stratagems**
- **Stoke the Fires** (1 CP) — *A Class 4–5 unit is fed to the Furnace:* It also gets +2″ MOV this activation.
- **Emergency Weld** (1 CP) — *A Class 3–5 unit is damaged:* Heal 2 MIGHT.
- **Daemonic Fury** (1 CP) — *A Class 3–5 unit is selected to Fight:* +1 Damage on its melee weapons.

## Detachment — Iron Within

*Iron legionaries and siege-guard holding the line.*

**Detachment rule:** Iron Within, Iron Without: once per round per unit, when targeted, incoming PEN −1 and re-roll ARM saves of 1 for that attack.

**Enhancements**
- **Bastion-Seal** (+10 pts, Iron-Warden Champion): The attached unit has WARD 5+.
- **Ironclad Pauldrons** (+10 pts, Iron-Forged Legionaries): +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) against PEN 0 and −1.

**Stratagems**
- **Hold the Breach** (1 CP) — *A unit is charged:* Its Retaliation Strike gets +1 Attack.
- **No Retreat** (1 CP) — *A unit would be Rattled:* It is not.
- **Smog and Smoke** (1 CP) — *Command Phase:* Friendly Class 1–2 units within 9″ of a Class 4–5 unit are [STEALTH] until the End of Round.
